police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: We will verify the locker access receipt and keep its source intact. A lead is not a rescue; we cannot assume Victor stayed there.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: I will check the technical trail behind the locker access receipt. Amara, tell me what the records cannot explain.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I am following the locker access receipt without police backup. Amara has my location; I am not going to turn this into a contest with Victor.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The next lead is the locker access receipt. We need its original source before Victor moves again.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I recognise Ethan's little blanket. I will not mistake that for knowing he is safe.
